payload.function_structure: Overall function: drive an iteration from drawn machine to shipped record under owner control. Sub-functions, solution-neutral (verb + noun): A execute the drawing - compile drawing, validate machine, hold token set, activate successors, hold joins, seed sub-machines, record history. B serve the work - serve packets, attach guidance, resolve method links, assign states to sessions, record actor, collect evidence, validate evidence form, pin evidence. C adjudicate - make offer, replace offer, dismiss offer, supersede offer, record grant, advance machine. D keep the rhythm - run commands in background, expose run handle, report completion, scope verification to milestones, refuse out-of-scope test runs, guard commit window, demand updates, guard boot with named project. E keep the record - log one line per dispatch, carry clause on failure, aggregate logs (filter, group, count), mark notes drained, project handover (latest verify by time), stamp roles not names. F show the truth - render branches side by side, highlight tokens, surface offers, show iteration tabs. G maintain the system - reload engine on change, manage owned processes, edit plan (insert, renumber, freeze started), ripple renames across links, serve declared roots, derive lean as strike-list, inherit product artifacts (check sufficiency, accept pointer evidence).
payload.coverage: Every requirement maps: the 9 executor/machine reqs land in A+B+F (req-exec-parallel -> activate successors + hold joins; req-exec-tokens -> hold token set + record history; req-exec-seed -> seed sub-machines; req-exec-multi-agent -> assign states + record actor; req-board-parallel -> render side by side; req-state-inherit -> inherit artifacts; req-verify-milestone-scope + req-1s-interactive -> D; req-offer-lane -> C). The 5 session laws land in D (test lane, commit window, toll, boot) and E (grant roles). The 3 record reqs land in E. The 8 lane/ops reqs land in G. Use-case steps: uc-3/4/8 covered by A+B+F, uc-7 by E, uc-2 by C (offer surface; phone transport rides i7), uc-9 by E (record completeness), uc-6 untouched by i3 (hand-edit rehash exists since i2f) - no orphan functions, no unmapped requirements.
